name: VSTECS
recent: VSTECS 在 2026 年 11 月 18 日公布季度业绩，净利按年增长近 18%，并宣布每股 0.93 仙的第一次中期股息。公司于 10 月 28 日完成出售 ISATEC 40% 股权，套现约 RM48.75 百万，ISATEC 不再为联营公司。执行董事 Foo Lek Choong 在 10 月至 11 月间多次申报持股变动，包括在闭门期内的交易。
notable: 完成出售 ISATEC 40% 股权予 Skyform Pte Ltd，现金代价约 RM48.75 百万。
宣布第一次中期股息每股 0.93 仙，除权日为 2026 年 12 月 15 日。
公布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止季度业绩，净利按年增长近 18%。
risks: 执行董事 Foo Lek Choong 在闭门期内及前后多次进行股份交易，包括 10 月 22 日及 11 月 6 日各增持 150,000 股。
公司于 10 月 23 日对闭门期交易意向公告作出更正，修正直接持股百分比。
earnings: 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度营收为 RM1,078.2 百万，按年增长 31.7%，按季增长 3.0%；净利为 RM30.3 百万，按年增长 50.3%，按季增长 32.4%；净利率为 2.8%，高于上一季度的 2.2%。

recent_en: VSTECS announced its quarterly results on 18 November 2026, with net profit up nearly 18% year-on-year, and declared a first interim dividend of 0.93 sen per share. The company completed the disposal of its 40% stake in ISATEC on 28 October for about RM48.75 million, ceasing ISATEC as an associate. Executive Director Foo Lek Choong filed multiple shareholding changes between October and November, including dealings during the closed period.
notable_en: Completed the disposal of a 40% stake in ISATEC to Skyform Pte Ltd for a cash consideration of about RM48.75 million.
Declared a first interim dividend of 0.93 sen per share, with ex-date on 15 December 2026.
Announced quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026, with net profit up nearly 18% year-on-year.
risks_en: Executive Director Foo Lek Choong conducted multiple share trades during and around the closed period, including acquiring 150,000 shares each on 22 October and 6 November.
The company issued an amended announcement on 23 October to rectify the percentage of direct interest in the intention to deal during closed period.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM1,078.2 million, up 31.7% year-on-year and 3.0% quarter-on-quarter; net profit was RM30.3 million, up 50.3% year-on-year and 32.4% quarter-on-quarter; net margin was 2.8%, higher than 2.2% in the previous quarter.
